title: Why Tourists Are OBSESSED With Korean Convenience Stores 🍜 #shorts #korea
description:
Why do tourists spend MORE at Korean 7-Eleven and CU than shopping malls? You can cook fresh, bubbling ramen right inside the store, add melted cheese, triangle kimbap, and iconic Banana Milk—all for under $6!

Would you try this midnight meal in Seoul? Comment below!
